tldr: With fixed binary potential outcomes, exact public treatment and control responder totals \(N/2\), and one balanced complete randomization, the causal individual-benefit share has limiting all-original-record minimax risk \(c(h)=V_G(h)/16\). The credited Gaussian correlation experiment has a proved endpoint-prior frontier \(\mathcal E=(0,h_*]\), with \(0.8010<h_*<0.8012\), and singleton relative boundary \(\{h_*\}\) belonging to the regime. A terminating \(\mathsf{Frontier}\) encloses that boundary to arbitrary precision. For every fixed band, the full-coordinate \(\mathsf{Eval}\) computes matching prior, rule, and global risk certificates at every prescribed tolerance. Their observable lifts are total and asymptotically uniformly minimax for the original fixed cohort. Complementary-band least-favorable support topology and exhaustive classical priority clearance remain unresolved.
